summary: Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Assignment and Transfer Agreement with FreeT Inc. (formerly CNP Roen/Inscobee) on August 19, 2026. Under the agreement, FreeT irrevocably assigned to Apimeds all its rights in Apitox, including 100% of Korean medicine clinic market rights, a 25% royalty on US commercialization proceeds, and 25% revenue participation from overseas rights. The company assumes only post-effective obligations. No price, premium, advisors, or close date disclosed. Watch for future Apitox development/commercialization transactions and litigation risks from prior side letters.
